verdict.rationale: All three distribution routes in the story are documented. The set is in Claude Code's official marketplace and has plugin-marketplace installs for Codex and Copilot. `npx skills add` also writes editable skill files into the project, where they can be committed and updated on demand. A hands-on probe confirmed a non-interactive install into ./.claude/skills/. Missing for 10: explicit team-rollout guidance (e.g. project-scoped plugin config that teammates pick up automatically, or documented commit-and-share workflow for a whole team).
